verdicts.reason: A keeps the 'Quiet Hours' book, the confetti and a clear centred stack (logo, kicker, headline, body, CTA, legal) that reads left to right. Its flaws are that the cream panel bleeds off the top, right and bottom edges with no margin, and the logo and legal line are small. B drops the book, which is the key hero image. It shrinks the Inkwell & Lantern logo to an unreadable speck in the top-left corner, pushes the body copy into a cramped right column with ragged wrapping, and makes the fine print illegibly tiny.
